name: Heel Touches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, a little wider than hips.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor, arms by your sides.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel by bending sideways.
Return to the middle and reach to the left heel.
cues: Bend sideways, do not sit up

common_mistakes.mistake: Dropping the head and shoulders between reps
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the shoulders up for the whole set
Pause for a second on each side

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet too close to the body
common_mistakes.fix: Place the feet so the fingertips just reach the heels
